tools.name: samcart_list_orders
tools.description: List orders (purchases) with status, totals, currency, customer and cart items. Filter by email, customer, product, funnel or status. Good first call for sales questions. API: GET /orders.

tools.name: samcart_get_order
tools.description: Get one order by id: totals, payment method, billing and shipping address, attribution, custom fields and cart items. API: GET /orders/{id}.

tools.name: samcart_list_customers
tools.description: List customers with name, email, phone, tags and marketing consent status. Filter by exact email or phone. API: GET /customers.

tools.name: samcart_get_customer
tools.description: Get one customer by id. API: GET /customers/{id}.

tools.name: samcart_list_subscriptions
tools.description: List subscriptions with status, price, interval, rebill counts and next rebill date. Filter by customer, product, order, status or type. API: GET /subscriptions.

tools.name: samcart_get_subscription
tools.description: Get one subscription by id: status, price, interval, coupon, scheduled cancellation, start and end dates. API: GET /subscriptions/{id}.

tools.name: samcart_get_subscription_history
tools.description: List status changes of one subscription (for example active to canceled), with source and time. API: GET /subscriptions/{id}/history.

tools.name: samcart_list_products
tools.description: List products with name, SKU, price, currency, pricing type, stock and sales page URL. Filter by category, pricing type, SKU or archived state. API: GET /products.

tools.name: samcart_get_product
tools.description: Get one product by id: price, currency, pricing type, stock, subscription terms and sales page URL. API: GET /products/{id}.

tools.name: samcart_list_charges
tools.description: List payment charges with amount, currency, status (charged, refunded, partially_refunded), processor and order or subscription link. API: GET /charges.

tools.name: samcart_list_refunds
tools.description: List refunds with amount, currency, charge, order and customer ids, and creation time. API: GET /refunds.

tools.name: samcart_list_prospects
tools.description: List prospects: people who entered their details on a checkout without buying. One row per person and product. API: GET /prospects.

tools.name: samcart_get_daily_sales_report
tools.description: Daily sales rows for a date range: gross sales, net revenue, orders, refunds, recurring and one-time sales, upsells, views and conversion. Amounts are in the smallest currency unit. API: GET /reports/daily-sales.

tools.name: samcart_get_mrr_report
tools.description: Current monthly recurring revenue (MRR) of the marketplace's active subscriptions. API: GET /reports/mrr.

tools.name: samcart_update_order_custom_fields
tools.description: Set custom field values on one order. Only the slugs you send change. An empty string or null ERASES the stored value. Slugs come from the custom_fields map of samcart_get_order. API: PATCH /orders/{id}.

tools.name: samcart_cancel_customer_subscription
tools.description: CANCEL a subscription immediately. Only active, delinquent or paused subscriptions can be canceled. The customer is notified unless silent_cancel is true. There is no undo through this tool. API: POST /subscriptions/{id}/cancel.

tools.name: samcart_schedule_customer_cancellation
tools.description: SCHEDULE a cancellation for an active subscription: at the end of the current billing period (end_of_period) or on a custom future date (custom, needs cancel_date YYYY-MM-DD). API: POST /subscriptions/{id}/schedule-cancel.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: samcart_list_orders, samcart_list_customers, samcart_list_products, samcart_get_product · Public sink: samcart_list_orders, samcart_list_customers, samcart_update_order_custom_fields, samcart_cancel_customer_subscription, samcart_schedule_customer_cancellation.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: samcart_list_orders, samcart_list_customers, samcart_list_products, samcart_get_product · Public sink: samcart_list_orders, samcart_list_customers, samcart_update_order_custom_fields, samcart_cancel_customer_subscription, samcart_schedule_customer_cancellation

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
